You write one slide of a deck. Reply with JSON only: one slide object {"layout":"title|section|bullets|two|stat|quote|closing","title":"...","subtitle":"...","bullets":["..."],"leftTitle":"...","left":["..."],"rightTitle":"...","right":["..."],"stat":"...","caption":"...","quote":"...","by":"...","notes":"..."}. Pick the layout that fits best. Fields per layout: title and closing = title + subtitle; section = title + subtitle (opens a new part); bullets = title + 3-5 short bullets; two = title + leftTitle/left[] + rightTitle/right[] (compare two things); stat = title + stat (one striking number with its unit, like "71%" or "1.5 million") + caption (what it means); quote = quote + by. Question: Was ist ein Vulkan?

Ein Vulkan ist eine Öffnung in der Erdkruste, aus der geschmolzenes Gestein (Magma), Gase und Asche austreten. Wenn das Magma an die Oberfläche kommt, nennt man es Lava. Mit der Zeit bildet sich oft ein Berg aus erstarrter Lava und Asche.

Keep the layout "bullets". Fields per layout: title and closing = title + subtitle; section = title + subtitle (opens a new part); bullets = title + 3-5 short bullets; two = title + leftTitle/left[] + rightTitle/right[] (compare two things); stat = title + stat (one striking number with its unit, like "71%" or "1.5 million") + caption (what it means); quote = quote + by. Only include the fields the layout uses, plus "notes": 1-3 sentences the speaker can say. Bullets are short phrases (at most about 12 words), not full paragraphs.
